description: Regards d'égouts is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Cet ensemble des données ponctuelles montre les regards d’égouts situés sur l’île de Montréal. Ces regards sont des compartiments par lesquels on a accès aux égouts pour les nettoyer, les inspecter et les entretenir. Les regards sont placés à intervalles réguliers sur la section droite de la conduite principale. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Chambre, Eau, Eau usée, Infrastructure, Pluvial. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, FGDB, JSON. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
